questions.q:
A flask is filled with equal moles of $A$ and $B$. The half lives of $A$ and $B$ are $100s$ and $50s$ respectively and are independent of the initial concentration. The time required for the concentration of $A$ to be four times that of $B$~is____s$.
(Given : $ln2 = 0 . 693)
questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.solution:
For first order reaction

$k = \dfrac{0 . 693}{t\dfrac{1}{2}}$

\left[A\right] = 4 \left[B\right]$

\left[A\right]0e^{- {k}_{A}t} = 4\left[B\right]0e^{- {k}_{B}t}$

$∵$ as~\left[A\right]0 = \left[B\right]0; e^{- {k}_{A}t} = 4e^{- {k}_{B}t}$

$- {k}_{A}t = ln4 - {k}_{B}t$

$∴ t\left({k}_{B} - {k}_{A}\right) =2ln2$

$t = 2 \times0 . 693\left(\dfrac{0 . 693}{50} - \dfrac{0 . 693}{100}\right) = \dfrac{2 \times 100}{2 - 1} =200sec$

$

questions.q: Consider a complex reaction taking place in three steps with rate constants $k_1, k_2$ and $k_3$ respectively. The overall rate constant $k$ is given by the expression $k=\sqrt{\frac{k_1 k_3}{k_2}}$. If the activation energies of the three steps are 60,30 and $10 \mathrm{~kJ} \mathrm{~mol}{ }^{-1}$ respectively, then the overall energy of activation in $\mathrm{kJ} \mathrm{mol}^{-1}$ is $\ldots\ldots$ . (Nearest integer)
questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.solution:
$\mathrm{k}_1, \mathrm{k}_2$ and $\mathrm{k}_3$ are given as rate constants of three steps of a complex reaction. Rate constant (k) of the overall reaction is given as
$k=\sqrt{\frac{k_1 k_3}{k_2}}$
Activation energies of the three steps are given as
$\begin{aligned}
& \mathrm{E}_{\mathrm{a}_1}=60 \mathrm{~kJ} \mathrm{~mol}^{-1}, \mathrm{E}_{\mathrm{a}_2}=30 \mathrm{~kJ} \mathrm{~mol}^{-1}, \\
& \mathrm{E}_{\mathrm{a}_3}=10 \mathrm{~kJ} \mathrm{~mol}^{-1}
\end{aligned}$
From Arrhenius equation, we know that
$\mathrm{k}=\mathrm{Ae}^{-\mathrm{Ea} / \mathrm{RT} T}$
If $E_a$ is the activation energy of the overall reaction, then
$\begin{aligned}
& E_a=\frac{1}{2}\left[E_{a_1}+E_{a_3}-E_{a_2}\right] \\
& =\frac{1}{2}[60+10-30]=20 \mathrm{~kJ} \mathrm{~mol}^{-1}
\end{aligned}$

questions.q:
A radioactive element has a half life of $200$ days. The percentage of original activity remaining after $83$ days is____(Nearest integer)
(Given : antilog $0 . 125 = 1 . 333$, antilog $0 . 693 = 4 . 93$)
questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.solution:
For first order reaction,

$K = \dfrac{2 . 303}{t}log\dfrac{No}{Nt}$~...~ \left(1\right)$

Also,~$K = \dfrac{0 . 693}{t\dfrac{1}{2}}$~...~ \left(2\right)$

Equating~ \left(1\right)$~and~ \left(2\right)$

Hence,~$\dfrac{2 . 303}{t}log\dfrac{No}{Nt} = \dfrac{0 . 693}{t\dfrac{1}{2}}$

$\dfrac{2 . 303}{83}log\dfrac{No}{Nt} = \dfrac{0 . 693}{200}$

$\dfrac{No}{Nt} = \dfrac{4}{3}$

$% \dfrac{Nt}{N0} = 0 . 75 \times 100$

$= 75 %$

questions.q: At $345K$, the half life for the decomposition of a sample of a gaseous compound initially at $55 . 5kPa$ was $340s$. When the pressure was $27 . 8kPa$, the half life was found to be~$170s$. The order of the reaction is - [integer answer]

questions.solution:
$\dfrac{\left({t}_{1 / 2}\right)1}{\left({t}_{1 / 2}\right)2} = \left(\dfrac{P1}{P2}\right)1 - n$

$⇒ \dfrac{340}{170} = \left(\dfrac{55 . 5}{27 . 8}\right)1 - n$

$1 = 1 - n ⇒ n = 0$

For zero order reaction half life is directly proportional to the initial concentration.

questions.q:
The reaction& $2NO + {Br}_{2} \to 2NOBr$~takes place through the mechanism given below

$NO + {Br}_{2}⇌{NOBr}_{2} \left(fast\right)$

${NOBr}_{2} + NO \to 2NOBr \left(slow\right)$

The overall order of the reaction is _____.
questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.solution:
$On applying Law of mass action& over slowest step,

$R = k [ {NOBr}_{2} ] [ NO ]$

The slowest step is the rate determining step.

On applying Law of mass action on equilibrium of Step I

$k = \left[{NOBr}_{2}\right] \left[NO\right]\left[{Br}_{2}\right]

\left[{NOBr}_{2}\right] =$k \left[NO\$right]\left[{Br}_{2}\right]

Hence, overall rate equation will be

$R = k \left[$NO\right]2 \left[{Br}_{2}\right]$

= k ' \left[NO\right]2 \left[{Br}_{2}\right]

The overall order is equal to sum of the powers of the concentration terms in the rate law.

The overall order of the reaction is 3.

$

questions.q: For a reaction $A \to 2B + C$ the half lives are $100s$ and $50s$ when the concentration of reactant $A$ is $0 . 5$~and $1 . 0molL =$ respectively. The order of the reaction is
questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.solution:
The relation between half-life and initial concentration of& $n^{th}$~order reaction can be written as follows,

$t\dfrac{1}{2} ∝ \dfrac{1}{\left[{A}_{0}\right]n - 1}$

\left[100\right] ∝ \dfrac{1}{\left(0 . 5\right)n - 1}$

\left(50\right) ∝ \dfrac{1}{\left(1\right)n - 1}$

\left[2\right]1 = \left[\dfrac{1}{0 . 5}\right]n - 1$

\left[2\right]1 = \left[2\right]n - 1$

$n - 1 = 1$

$n = 2$

order~$= 2$

For the second order reactions half-life is inversely proportional to initial concentration.
